name: Gillette Restaurant Equipment
old_description: at Gillette Restaurant Equipment is to provide the best NEW and USED kitchen equipment and supplies while offering superior customer service, quality consulting, innovative design and expedient deliveries!
about:
Gillette Restaurant Equipment was founded in 1989 by Ann Tyler in North Brookfield, Massachusetts. What began as a woman-owned venture to provide economical solutions for restaurant startups has grown into a regional supplier with two showrooms — in North Brookfield and Holyoke — supported by five warehouses across central Massachusetts.

The company stocks a full line of new and used commercial kitchen equipment, including cooking, bakery, refrigeration, ice machines, bar equipment, display cases, and stainless steel accessories. Inventory is sourced from major manufacturers and professionally inspected used units, allowing customers to choose between new and cost-effective pre-owned options. Beyond sales, Gillette provides consulting, layout planning, and equipment selection services to help operators design or upgrade commercial kitchens from concept through delivery.

Primary customers are independent restaurants, bars, catering operations, and other food-service businesses throughout New England. The team works with both new ventures and existing establishments looking to expand or replace equipment, offering project coordination that covers specification, procurement, and logistics.

Gillette emphasizes an economical approach to kitchen outfitting, combining product availability with design consulting and fast delivery. The company’s stated goal remains the same as at its founding: to supply quality equipment and expert guidance without exceeding the operator’s budget.
